The '''Iridium Rod''' is a [[Tools|tool]] used to catch [[fish]]. It can be purchased from [[Fish Shop|Willy's Fish Shop]] for {{Price|7500}} after reaching [[Skills#Fishing|Fishing level 6]]. It can have both [[bait]] and [[tackle]] attached to it.

The Iridium Rod can be given a random [[Forge#Tool enchantments|enchantment]] at the Forge.

==Secret==
{{collapse|content=
Putting [[Secrets#Lucky Purple Shorts|Lucky Purple Shorts]] in the tackle slot of a fishing rod changes the [[Fish Shop#Bobber Machine|bobber style]] to a unique Lucky Purple Shorts bobber. This cannot be done with Trimmed Lucky Purple Shorts.}}
